div.p:
Free Stock (Available)
?
Total free (unreserved) quantity across all internal locations. Formula: Sum(quantity - reserved_quantity) per quant. Click to view the full stock quant list.

Total Stock Value
?
Ending inventory value across all internal locations. Automated costing uses valuation layer values. Manual costing: quantity x standard price. Click to browse all storable products.

COGS (Period)
?
Cost of Goods Sold: total cost of items delivered to customers in the selected period. Uses stock valuation layers (AVCO/FIFO) where available. Fallback: quantity x standard price.

Received Value (Period)
?
Total cost of items received from suppliers in the selected period. Uses stock valuation layers where available. Fallback: quantity x standard price.

Inventory Turnover
?
Annualized rate at which inventory is sold and replaced. Formula: (COGS / Average Inventory Value) x (365 / period days). Higher values indicate faster-moving stock.

DIO (Days in Stock)
?
Days Inventory Outstanding: average days inventory sits before being sold. Formula: (Average Inventory Value / COGS) x period days. Lower values mean faster inventory conversion.
div.small: Avg Inv / COGS x Period Days

div.p:
Low Stock Alerts
?
Count of storable products whose Forecasted Quantity is at or below their configured reorder point. Reorder points are defined in Inventory > Reorder Rules. Click to view all reorder rules.

Dead Stock
?
Products with stock on hand but zero inbound or outbound movement in the last days. Threshold is configured from the sidebar. Click to view stock quants for investigation.

Total Products
?
Total count of storable products (detailed_type = 'product') matching the current filters. Service and consumable products are excluded. Click to browse all matching products.
